form.label: Sign-ins and errors
form.description: Sign-in attempts, new accounts and sign-outs, and the Functions that answered 500. Visitors are identified by a hash of their IP address; the site never sends the address itself, or any password.

search.query: `ptf_events` event_type="login" action="failure" | stats count BY reason

panel.title: Visitors with the most failed sign-ins

search.query: `ptf_events` event_type="login" action="failure" | stats count AS failures dc(user) AS accounts values(user) AS tried values(src_country) AS countries max(_time) AS last_attempt BY src_ip_hash | sort 10 -failures | eval last_attempt=strftime(last_attempt, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"), tried=mvjoin(mvindex(tried, 0, 4), ", ") | rename src_ip_hash AS "Visitor (IP hash)", failures AS Failures, accounts AS Accounts, tried AS "Usernames tried", countries AS "Connecting from", last_attempt AS "Last attempt"

`ptf_events` (event_type="signup" OR event_type="logout") | eval what=case(event_type=="signup" AND action=="success", "Accounts created", event_type=="signup", "Sign-ups refused (".coalesce(reason, "no reason").")", true(), "Sign-outs") | stats count AS Count BY what | rename what AS Activity

`ptf_events` event_type="error" | sort 0 -_time | eval when=strftime(_time, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | table when uri_path error cf_ray cf_colo | rename when AS Time, uri_path AS Path, error AS Error, cf_ray AS "CF-Ray", cf_colo AS Colo
